build.note: A release manifest names a clean commit. A dirty tree is developer evidence and cannot be a release acceptance.

ci.detail: A GitHub Actions run URL for this commit, or the local stages that stood in for it and why the remote run was unavailable.

docs.detail: The Docs workflow run URL (links, wiki references, referenced media), or the local equivalents that were run.

codeql.detail: The CodeQL security-and-quality analysis for this commit and its alert count. Null means not observed, never zero.

workflows.name: approve_refreshed_terms
workflows.evidence: An authenticated browser session: the stale screen is refused, the refreshed terms are displayed and the approval succeeds once.

workflows.name: replay_completed_decision
workflows.evidence: An authenticated browser replay of a completed decision through its guard, verdict and outcomes.

workflows.name: recover_interrupted_job
workflows.evidence: A queued/running allocation submission whose lease expired, recovered by the repair path without a second provider spend.

recording_manifest.notes: Step 11 records against this manifest. The acceptance record must be usable for recording and must name this commit.
